state.supplier: Harlow Precision Castings Ltd, company number 08814522, Brightside Lane, Sheffield, UK. Aluminium die-casting. Directors: Meera Okafor, Tom Lindqvist. Founded 2013.
state.blockers: Sanctions; fraud or bribery; insolvency or winding-up proceedings; a safety or environmental conviction or fine

hits.h01: 2024-05-14: Harlow Castings Inc. of Ohio fined $2.1M for falsifying safety test records.
hits.h02: 2022-11-03: Harlow Precision Castings wins the Sheffield Chamber of Commerce export award.
hits.h03: 2026-03-09: High Court list: winding-up petition presented against Harlow Precision Castings Ltd.
hits.h04: 2026-08-21: Harlow Precision Castings is hiring CNC operators at its Sheffield site.
hits.h05: 2025-06-30: Harlow Precision Cycles recalls 4,000 brake levers after a supplier defect.
hits.h06: 2025-09-12: Director Tom Lindqvist speaks at the UK casting industry conference.
hits.h07: 2023-02-01: Companies House notice: Harlow Precision Castings Ltd filed its annual accounts late.
hits.h08: 2026-01-17: Sanctions list update: Harlow Trading LLC (Dubai) added for export-control breaches.
hits.h09: 2024-04-02: Blog: ten die-casting suppliers in the UK worth a call, including Harlow Precision Castings.
hits.h10: 2025-12-05: Small fire at an industrial unit on Brightside Lane, Sheffield. No one was hurt.
hits.h11: 2026-07-11: Meera Okafor appointed director at Okafor Logistics.
hits.h12: 2021-10-20: Environment Agency fines Harlow Precision Castings Ltd £8,000 for a wastewater discharge breach.
